entry.description: Where the host starts: the TanStack router in the browser, and the Worker that answers /rpc and serves the app

routes.description: The document, the offline page, and one thin route for each Place, Settings among them, all inside Ledger's shell. The router reaches them through the generated route tree, so nothing imports them

preview.description: In development only: Ledger for a stand-in user, its server the real handlers over a table in memory in the tab, to try every key and gesture without signing in

app.description: Ledger's screens: the shell around every Place with its Sidebar, each Place, the sheets over them, and the parts they share

commands.description: The vocabulary: every Command with its keys, the gesture that gives it on a touch screen, the guide to every gesture, and how each sounds and shows when given

client.description: The browser's side of the server: who is signed in, and the user's money kept in IndexedDB and in step with D1

kit.description: What Ledger needed that no package has yet: sounds made on demand, the Thumb Lock with its Compass, and what the device can be driven by. Each knows nothing of Ledger

server.description: The Worker's side: the D1 table of every user's money, the Ledger API's handlers, and the host that answers /rpc for the signed-in user

infra.description: Deployable resources, composed by alchemy.run.ts: the D1 database, its table, and the Worker

domain.description: The words of money: Accounts, Categories, Entries and Preferences, the sums over them, and the Ledger API both sides speak

common.description: The theme the document boots with

kstack.description: Places over the vocabulary and the data; the data over the domain both sides speak; the kit and the domain at the bottom, knowing nothing above them
